name: geo-readiness-tests
description: Cypress end-to-end suite for the geo-readiness Jahia UI extension

comments.cross-fetch: Not used by this suite directly. @jahia/cypress 8.5.0 requires it from dist/support/apollo/links.js without declaring it, and @apollo/client 3.14 no longer pulls it in, so the support file fails to bundle without it. Remove once the dependency is declared upstream — see tests/README.md.
comments.mochawesome: Same story: dist/support/contextReporter.js requires mochawesome/addContext without declaring it. It doubles as this suite's reporter, so it is wanted here either way.
